subject: Request: temporary telemetry delay / P1-P2 response tolerance
messages:
From: Marta Lowe <marta@finsecure.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finsecure.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term tolerance to P1/P2 while we migrate telemetry

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

We're starting a region-wide telemetry migration tonight (rotating shifts across EU/US) that will temporarily increase false-positive alerts for our P1 detector. Engineering estimates a 6–12 hour window during which some P1 alerts will be noisy and likely to trigger on-call pages.

We'd like to request a formal, temporary tolerance: allow a 30 minute grace on initial P1 acknowledgement overnight for the maintenance window and a 2-hour tolerance for P2 follow-ups, while we stabilize the migration. We'll keep a tight communications channel open and escalate any genuine incidents.

Can Redwood confirm an exception, the official escalation path during the window, and any required paperwork we need to sign? I've attached the migration-plan.pdf and am happy to run a quick sync.

Thanks,
Marta Lowe
Director, Site Reliability
FinSecure

Attachments: migration-plan.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lowe <marta@finsecure.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term tolerance to P1/P2 while we migrate telemetry

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the migration plan.

We can support a temporary exception, but we need to align on two things before I confirm formally:

- Exact window (start/end timestamps) so we can adjust routing policies and on-call coverage.
- A concise escalation matrix (who to page first, secondary contacts) and a small runbook step for what constitutes a true P1 during noisy telemetry.

Operationally, I propose the following mitigations while we evaluate:
- Route FinSecure alerts to a dedicated shortened-pool with priority throttling for non-critical matches.
- Apply a 30-minute initial-ack tolerance for P1 between 01:00–07:00 PDT for the migration night(s) you specified.
- Karthik will disable automated severity promotions for the migration window to avoid noise-driven escalations.

I'll loop in Laura for approval on the formal exception (SLA amendment) and Ben to coordinate the customer comms and paperwork. If that's acceptable, I can send the exception PDF for signature and update routing by EOD.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0146

- Laura: SLA amendment needs VP approval for any change that affects P1 contract terms. Can you confirm availability for a 15-min sign-off?
- Karthik: can the on-call rota be adjusted for tonight? The roster attached (oncall-roster.csv) shows coverage gaps 02:00–04:00 PDT if we ask for a 30-min grace; we should patch by swapping one senior from tomorrow's day shift into tonight's window.
- Stephanie: if we accept a 30-minute ack tolerance we should also include a clause that Redwood will still perform immediate triage for any sign of customer-data exposure or production outage (no tolerance). Add that to the exception PDF.

Subject: Re: Request: short-term tolerance to P1/P2 while we migrate telemetry

Marta — following our internal approvals, confirmed items below and next steps: 

Confirmed exception (one-night window):
- Window: 2026-06-04 01:00–07:00 PDT (we will support this single maintenance window as requested).
- Tolerances: P1 initial-ack tolerance = 30 minutes between 01:00–07:00 PDT; P2 follow-up tolerance = 2 hours for the same window.
- Hard exclusions: any event indicating data exfiltration, sustained service latency >3x SLO, or customer-reported production loss will bypass tolerance and be handled as standard P1 immediately.

Escalation path during window:
1) First responder: on-call engineer (page) — contact details are in the attached oncall-roster.csv.
2) Secondary: Karthik Iyer (SRE lead) — paged if no ack in 30 minutes.
3) Exec escalation: Laura Bennett (VP, Customer Success) — for incidents with cross-customer impact or contractual exposure.

Attachments: SLA exception draft (sla-exception-request.pdf) — this includes the two tolerance clauses and the hard exclusion language. If you approve, please sign using the DocuSign link included in the PDF and reply with the signed copy. We will enable the routing adjustments at 00:30 PDT to give teams time to validate.

One operational note: we will disable automated severity promotions for alerts containing the telemetry-migration marker tag to reduce noise; we'll keep triage consoles monitored.

If you want a 15-minute quick call before we flip the routing, I can be on standby at 00:45 PDT tonight.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
